text: Deepa's daughter has her first piano recital on May 14. She's been practising every evening and is apparently terrified of the bit with the left hand. I should text Deepa that morning to wish her luck.
Isabel and her husband are running the half marathon together sometime next week. Their kids are making a banner.
Joe mentioned his brother Stefan is playing bass in a covers band now. First proper gig is June 3rd at the Crown.

Quick one from lunch with Keisha. Her mum has a hip replacement booked for the end of the month and Keisha is taking two weeks off to look after her. She sounded worn out. Need to check in with her once the op is done.
Mihai got through to the regional chess final! It's in early March, somewhere in Leeds.
Kavya's son Archie made the county under-12s. She's absolutely thrilled and wouldn't stop showing me videos.
Helen is vegetarian now, not pescatarian. Worth remembering before the dinner.
Don't forget to ask Kai how the climbing competition went on Saturday.
Wiremu said his partner Noor is doing her first stand-up set at an open mic on 5/14. He's more nervous than she is. I'm going along with him, so I'll grab tickets for both of us.
Abdi's dad turns seventy over the summer. The family are planning a surprise party but nothing's fixed yet.
Joseph's band split up, so the gig on June 20 is off. He seems fine about it, honestly a bit relieved.
Samir has been learning the cello for about a year. He'd love some proper rosin and a decent stand, if I ever need a present idea for him.
Xavier and Eli are flying to Lisbon at the end of the month for Eli's sister's wedding.
Must ring Saanvi this week. Her grandfather passed away on Tuesday and the funeral is sometime next week in Birmingham.
Pick up the dry cleaning, renew the parking permit, and book the car in for its MOT before the end of the month.
Hamza's daughter Zoe is in the school production of Matilda. Opening night is April 9th, then two more shows that week. Hamza is doing the lights, which explains why he looked exhausted.

Anya told me her brother Rafael is moving back from Toronto in early March. Their mum is overjoyed and has already redecorated his old room, even though he's not staying there. He's staying with Anya until he finds a flat, which she's slightly dreading because he plays the drums. He's also hoping to find a band to join once he's settled.
Dawit runs the Great North Run every year. This will be his ninth.

Bethany said her husband's band are playing the Jazz Café on July 2nd. It's their first London show, and he's been rehearsing in the garage most nights, which the neighbours love. I'm going with Ciara, and we're meeting for food first. Bethany says he gets awful stage fright, so it might be nice to send him a good luck message that afternoon.
Called Manon back. Her dog Biscuit had surgery on his leg yesterday and is home now, wobbly but okay. Her kids have been carrying him around the garden. I should send her something to cheer her up.

Mai is captain of her netball team this season. They've got a cup semi-final on October 28 and she's really anxious about it because they lost the same match last year. Her partner Jun is going to watch, and her little brother is coming along with a homemade sign. If they win, the final is sometime in mid November. Worth asking her how it went.
Rana's twins started secondary school last month. One loves it, the other has been struggling to make friends.
Talked to Jun about the cycling sportive. He did the full hundred miles on Sunday in just under seven hours. Remind me to send him the photos I took at the finish.
Naledi sings in a gospel choir and they're competing at a festival in Cardiff sometime in November. Her mum and aunties are all going to watch. Find out the date and see if I can go too.
Deepa's husband Kai has a new job at the hospital, starting on 6/1.
Isabel mentioned Joe's mum is unwell again. She doesn't know the details and didn't want to ask him directly.

Coffee with Mrs Walsh from next door. Her grandson Eli is in the junior swimming championships on May 22nd, and she's knitting him a lucky hat. Her own birthday is the week after. I want to get her a nice orchid; she said hers died over the winter.
Keisha's brother Hamza finally passed his driving test! Third time lucky. Must send him a congratulations text.
Stefan is obsessed with Formula 1 and supports Ferrari, poor thing.
Mihai and his wife Isabel are hosting a housewarming on Saturday the 14th. I'm bringing dessert.

Long chat with Archie on the phone. His sister Saanvi is doing a solo violin audition for the National Youth Orchestra in early March and has barely slept. Their dad keeps telling her to relax, which is making it worse. Archie is driving her down to London for it. I said I'd come to her recital at the end of the month as a practice run. Should drop Saanvi a message the night before the audition.
Wiremu supports the All Blacks and will not hear a word against them.
Zoe's exam results come out sometime next week. She's convinced she failed maths, though her teacher thinks otherwise.
Need to buy a birthday card for Helen. Her birthday is June 12th, and she's been hinting about a new yoga mat.
Gym, then Mum's, then the grocery shop. Remember the bin collection moved to Thursday this week.
Ciara's son had a nasty fall at football training and broke his wrist. He's in a cast for six weeks and gutted to miss the league final on April 30.
Kavya is doing a 10k in aid of the hospice where her grandmother was cared for. The race is May 3rd. I should sponsor her before the end of the week.

Joe Murphy, or Murph as everyone calls him, is retiring from the club after twenty years. There's a send-off match in the afternoon and a dinner on June 7, and his wife and grandkids are all coming. The committee is collecting for a framed shirt. I should chip in by the end of the month and sign the card when it goes round.

Samir and Rana got engaged over the weekend! He proposed at the top of Arthur's Seat, and apparently her mum knew for weeks and managed not to say a word. No date set yet but they're thinking sometime next summer, probably in Rana's home town. Need to get them a card and something small to celebrate.
Noor's daughter is doing her grade 5 ballet exam on 3/18. Noor says she's very calm about it, unlike Noor.
Rafael is training for his black belt grading in the middle of next month. He's nervous because his instructor is strict. Text him good luck the day before.

Abdi said his wife Mai is expecting their second, due early March. Their eldest, Dawit, keeps asking if it's a brother and has already picked out a football for the baby. Mai has had bad morning sickness and has cut down to three days a week at work. Abdi's mum is coming over from Ethiopia to help sometime in February.
Dentist moved to the 19th at 4pm. Still need to sort out the car insurance renewal.
Bethany has a cat called Pickle who eats cucumbers. Apparently that's how he got the name.
Jun's sister Naledi is performing in the Edinburgh Fringe this August. A one-woman show about their grandmother. He sounded proud and a bit emotional about it.

Saw Eli at the school gates. His husband Xavier is in hospital after a cycling accident, and Eli is juggling the kids and work on his own. He's clearly not sleeping. I really must call him tomorrow and offer to do the school run on Wednesday and Friday.
Deepa and Stefan both work at the council, though in different departments. They only found out last week.
Manon is coeliac and hates fuss being made about it.
Helen's brother Joseph has a big presentation to the board on June 3rd. If it goes well he'll probably be promoted.

Kai's mum was in a choir competition in Galway over the weekend and they came second, out of fourteen choirs. She's seventy-two and only joined two years ago after his dad died. Kai said it's the happiest he's seen her in ages. She is already planning for next year and wants to try a solo.
Text Anya to ask how the band's first gig went last night.
Isabel's book club has gone from monthly to fortnightly. She seems to love it.
Remind me to ask Keisha about her niece's graduation. It was sometime last week and I forgot completely.
Archie has started rock climbing three nights a week. His girlfriend Kavya got him into it, and now they're planning a trip to the Dolomites over the summer.
Ran into Dr Andersson at the pharmacy. She's off to Sweden for her father's eightieth on August 9, and her son Hamza is staying behind to look after their dog Rolo.
Mihai's wedding anniversary is the 22nd. His wife wants a weekend away. He asked me not to let him forget, so I should text him a week before.
Wiremu's kids are both in the regional swimming gala on May 14 and June 3rd. His partner is doing the driving for one, he's doing the other.
Nothing much today. Rained all afternoon, finished the crossword.
Rana and her husband have tickets for Hamilton at the end of the month. It's her birthday treat, and he's booked dinner too.

Bethany's mum is struggling since the breakup with her partner of fifteen years. Bethany is visiting her every weekend for now. I should take Bethany out for a drink sometime next week; she could do with a break herself.
